proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: removing the argon-atmosphere operation could permit oxygen or moisture to perturb the air-sensitive iridium-catalyst/boron-reagent system. This is an uncalibrated counterfactual, not an observed outcome.

Hypothesis: shortening the 80 °C stirred reaction hold from the recorded 12 h to the existing 90 min duration could leave conversion incomplete. The substituted duration is already present in the source procedure.

Hypothesis: deleting the provisional reactor-to-heater connection represents loss of the heating-block coupling and could prevent attainment or maintenance of the intended reaction temperature. This is a soft apparatus-configuration risk.
